newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks end higher on incentives package.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks end higher on incentives package.

text.p: Pakistani stocks finished higher on Wednesday amid bullish sentiment prompted by an incentives package for capital markets that the government announced on Tuesday, dealers said.
"A lot of speculative and retail investors were in the market chasing liquid scrips," dealer Sajjad Mankani of BMA Capital Management said.
The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index rose 20 points, or 1.30 percent, to close at 1,561.31 at 0904 GMT. Gainers led losers 104 to 102.
Hub Power Co rose 1.10 rupees to 38.30 rupees and Dewan Salman Fibre 1.25 to 36.30.
